ground_truth_note: Authored development fixture, excluded from held-out pantry evaluation. Status response is visible only when queried at its modeled time. Staff actions below are conditional opportunities, never automatic facts or agent permissions.

requires: valid source hold for 16 partner kits
payload.note: Conditional response rule is identical across policies. No arrival is invented if prerequisites are absent.
payload.timing_rule: Active from 12:30. After a valid stock_transfer hold/task, wait the configured two minutes. Respond before the exclusive 12:50 cutoff if task, hold and grant remain valid. This is a response rule, not a one-shot 12:35 opportunity.

requires: staff available for declared service window
payload.quantity_rule: min(remaining_committed_reserved_stock, original_target - cumulative_distributed, max(0, floor(service_rate * qualified_staff_minutes) - cumulative_distributed)). Process completion at 13:40 before closing the service window. Unmet target remains visible.

payload.note: Outside event window. No automatic stock credit, cannot satisfy deadline retrospectively.

outcome_checks: Expected S20 quantities never satisfy physical supply checks before a valid matched receipt.
Partner handoff conserves combined on-hand stock: 24 + 16 becomes 40 + 0.
Agent cannot attest stock receipt or distribution.
Target-linked distribution reaches 40 by 13:40 only if its preconditions actually hold.
Source reservation is consumed or released exactly once by handoff; recipient stock requires its own reservation.
Every duplicate receipt/distribution reference is rejected or returns its original result even under a fresh idempotency key.
Available stock is never negative. Released or expired holds never recreate distributed units.
Initial supply shortfall 16 and service deficit 40 remain distinct. No action silently reduces goal quantity 40.
A failed or partial recovery stays visible and is scored against the original target.
candidate_expectation: Consider the confirmed same-venue partner stock when the delayed S20 cannot meet the service deadline. Compare permitted partial service and full service after a real sandbox staff handoff. Do not hard-code a successful handoff or distribution.
